name: MySQL / MariaDB Database
description: Configure MySQL / MariaDB database server, create users, and access SQL Web Client
install_sudo: apt-get update && apt-get install -y mariadb-server mariadb-client

commands.restart_mysql_sudo: systemctl restart mariadb || systemctl restart mysql
commands.create_db_user_sudo: mysql -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS '{username}'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '{password}'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO '{username}'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
